external_sources.role: Inherited carry-free polynomial arithmetic supplies the older backend for all production final original residuals. Source 486 imports no production arithmetic.

inherited_mathematical_inputs: D120/D121: the positive k-th original child column is divisible by pi^k; fixed-mass contraction and integral low inverse.
D121: refined transport parameters at P=10552 and the CM truncation/kernel-error proof.
D121/D122: actual P=400 harmonic and CM banks, P=400 r=32 factor, exact masses and original branches.
D122: independent integer quotient arithmetic in source 486; all curve comparison bounds remain unchanged.
new_deductions: For fixed masses, T maps I_P={e:e_0=0, v_pi(e_k)>=max(0,P-k)} to pi^P in every output row.
If Tz-z belongs to I_P, then y=Tz has uniform original residual zero modulo pi^P.
Moment k, field coordinate i needs max(0,ceil((P-k-i)/8)) binary digits in weighted storage.
After eliminating r low moments, a high residual of valuation u needs only k<P-u; the next band ends at P-u-r-1.
Stop the weighted correction stage when u+r+1>=P, then reconstruct; this does not label weighted centers uniformly accurate.

timings.comparison_caveat: The uniform coordinator uses three chunk workers; shrinking sweeps are serial and import a saved seed. Summed phase durations are neither elapsed nor measured CPU time.

decision: Retain weighted Schur correction and original-operator reconstruction; combine them with resumable chunks before costing a larger column.
next_bounded_task: Use a new source, 496 next unused, to combine weighted layout and shrinking bands with state chunks, then measure one actual P=1600 column from verified P=800 with r=32, including factor, seed, correction, original residual and CM costs and peak memory.
